description: Buildroot Linux target for Luckfox Pico Plus/Pro/Max with reusable camera, media, display, GPIO, and SSH device surfaces.

backendNotes.simulator: EC2 Graviton is the primary simulation host, same model as linux-device target.
backendNotes.runtime: For EC2 simulation runtime, reuse tools under targets/linux-device/runtime.
backendNotes.target: Real device deploy path remains SSH over USB gadget network or LAN.
backendNotes.media: SC3336 video capture and H.264 encode are exposed through the board's RKMedia/Rockchip MPP interfaces.
backendNotes.display: Display hardware can be driven by framebuffer (/dev/fb0) or direct SPI depending on the selected BSP.
